raw_definitions: Definisi : n 1. chemistry of the Middle Ages and sixteenth century, alkimia; 2. miraculous power of transmutation, kesaktian, keajaiban: leaves turned to gold by the ~ of the seasons, daun-daun menguning oleh keajaiban musim; her beauty has a potent ~, kejelitaannya mempunyai kesaktian yg mujarab. (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
